milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the freestanding polished diorite pillar at spawn-relative (5, 1, 2) and face toward it, demonstrating they have located and observed the polished diorite. Target is the center of the 2-block tall pillar placed by /setblock ~5 ~0 ~2 and /setblock ~5 ~1 ~2. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable exploration range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the block rather than facing away. This rule type was chosen over position_inside_box because find tasks require the player to visually observe the target, not just stand near it.
